## Explanation

The sum of first n using even is n(n+1) while for the odd ones it is n*n;

Now to find the GCD we simply use the euclidean's method where we find the gcd
using:
int GCD(int num1,num2){
	if(num2==0) return num1;
	GCD(num2,num1%num2)
}
